messages:
tanya_cs: Quick heads-up: OrionAI wants a dedicated capacity dry-run next Friday 08:30 PST. Major asks: quota validation, autoscale sanity, and a 1hr surge dress rehearsal. Who leads orchestration + customer updates?

raj_ops: I can run orchestration and be on-rotations for test day. Need target QPS, SLOs (p99/p95), and a customer-facing status doc. @leo_engineering can you confirm priming and batching plan?

leo_engineering: On it. Proposed ramp: smoke -> gradual -> peak -> soak. Profile suggestion: 0 -> 50 -> 300 -> 1500 qps with 10m holds at each major step, total ~70m. Warm strategy: seed prefix+KV caches and run short context prompts to populate KV and KV cache. Example k6 snippet: 
```
k6 run --vus 150 --duration 60m orion_load.js
```
Will first run a canary against staging pool.

olivia_cust_eng: FYI Orion's renewal hinge calls out p99 < 1.5s for 256-token requests, and <0.5% errors during peak. If we miss those they flagged a financial clawback. Need continuous status updates during the rehearsal.

dan_product: To reduce cost and keep headroom, toggle to int8 quant variant for peak and enable continuous batching + prefix caching. Model alias we'll try: orion-gpt-1-int8. Add a rollback knob to fallback to hosted model if output regressions appear.

capacity-bot: pool-create finished: pool-id=orion-dedicated-1, gpus=6, region=us-west-2, provisioned_by=raj_ops

raj_ops: Draft runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orion-dryrun (internal). Timeline: Wed 14:00 small smoke (connectivity), Thu 09:00 priming window (cache warm + sample evals), Fri 08:30 full-rehearsal (ramp + chaos + soak). Chaos step: simulate network latency on one GPU node and trigger fallback. Rollback: traffic split back to hosted at 50% or stop test and drain.

tanya_cs: I'll prepare the customer-facing status doc and calendar invites. Also capture enablement items: SDK snippet, API key scopes, and an annotated load-test result template for their SREs.

leo_engineering: Small SDK snippet for preview (JS):
```
const resp = await redwood.responses.create({
  model: 'orion-gpt-1-int8',
  input: 'Summarize the transcript',
  max_tokens: 256,
  streaming: false,
});
```
Include note about header X-Redwood-Cache: prefix=true for priming requests.

dan_product: Also instrument output-sampling for regression checks (sample ~12k tokens across runs). Hook samples to evals dashboard for ML team review before sign-off.

olivia_cust_eng: I'll draft the renewal-risk brief in case p99 exceeds 1.5s. Also will keep a short post-test customer feedback form (3Qs): perceived latency (fast/ok/slow), any content regressions (yes/no), willingness to proceed with GA (yes/no).

raj_ops: Ops checklist (highlights): quota bumped (IAM ticket #3452), autoscale policy min=1 max=6, batching pinned for 256-token baseline, priming scripts uploaded to /ops/loadtests/orion. Pre-test: verify IAM quotas, credential scopes, and monitoring dashboards. During test monitor: p99, p95, errors, GPU util, token-cost, queue-length. Alert thresholds: p99 > 1.5s OR error-rate > 0.8% => pause and investigate.

leo_engineering: Chaos command to trigger network perturbation + traffic shift to hosted fallback (executed during peak hold):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/simulate-failure -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS' -d '{"pool":"orion-dedicated-1","failure":"net-latency","duration_s":120}'
# then split 40% traffic to hosted-fallback
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/traffic-split -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS' -d '{"from_pool":"orion-dedicated-1","to_pool":"hosted-fallback","percent":40}'
```
We'll watch for graceful degradation and correct routing.

raj_ops: Note for CS: please share the customer's contact cell for test-day coordination and decide escalation path if we hit regression (AE + SE + Eng on-call).

tanya_cs: Action items: raj_ops finalizes runbook and sends invites by EOD Tue; leo to run staging canary Wed; olivia prepares renewal brief and feedback form; dan stands by for sample reviews. I'll compile final checklist and customer-ready notes. :thumbsup:

olivia_cust_eng: I'll also collect post-test qualitative notes from the customer's SREs and include in the handoff.

raj_ops: Confirmed. I'll post the final runbook and invite links when ready. Test day on-call rota: raj_ops, leo_engineering, olivia_cust_eng, dan_product.

Tanya_cs: Thanks team. Let's keep updates tight this week.
